evaluation.confusion: Show TP/FN/FP/TN for strict-schema completed booleans, with unknown predictions, schema failures, truncation, runtime errors and not-run shown separately for each truth class. Those outcomes receive zero correctness without being relabelled as false predictions.
evaluation.limits: The selected panel is deliberately check-balanced and restricted to boards with matched pairs. It cannot estimate natural accuracy, evaluate promotion/castling/en-passant positives or identify why the failure occurs. No null-hypothesis significance claim from this finite descriptive diagnostic.

evaluation.secondary: Exact-schema valid /64, all-eight exact /64, all-field per-class support/correctness, predicted check-true count and full 64 outcome ledger. If schema-conditional rates appear, keep their smaller denominator visible and secondary.

intake_algorithm.acceptance: Process rows in physical source order and accept the first eligible pair from each new game until 32. Assign pair_id='mc-pair-'+format(accepted_index,'02d') for index0..31. Within the chosen pair order the two moves lexicographically and give case_id=pair_id+'-'+str(lexical_index) with indices0/1; IDs do not encode true class and are not in the model prompt. Repeated accepted puzzle identity is a hard integrity failure.
intake_algorithm.candidate_moves: Enumerate legal moves in lexicographic UCI order on that board. Reject promotions, castling and en passant from candidate pairing. Compute immediate capture status, captured-piece type, moving piece and check via board rules only. No engine, source-answer choice, model output or evaluation score.
intake_algorithm.generation_order: For each opaque case_id compute sha256(ASCII('matched-check-order-v1')+byte(10)+json.dumps({seed:4082032,case_id:case_id},sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=True).encode('utf-8')).hexdigest(); sort by (digest,case_id). Keep evaluator labels in this same sealed order without opening them in generation. Do not run all checking cases first or leak label-dependent names.
intake_algorithm.global_new_exclusions: After acceptance add that canonical game and all four role keys to the new-cohort exclusion union. The pre-move board intentionally appears twice in the two input records of its own pair; it may not recur in another pair or collide with any selected successor.
intake_algorithm.matched_pairs: Enumerate every unordered distinct move pair in lexical UCI order. Require the same from_square, moving piece/color, capture boolean and captured-piece type, with exactly one checking and one nonchecking move. Both successors must be valid, distinct, and absent from known and already accepted new keys. Also reject internal collision among source-before, setup-after and the two successor keys.
intake_algorithm.pair_rank: digest=sha256(ASCII('matched-check-pair-v1')+byte(10)+payload_bytes).hexdigest(); choose min((digest,uci1,uci2)). Choice is fixed after legality/exclusion/matching filters and independent of outputs. Do not modify eligibility to obtain favorable model results.
intake_algorithm.rejection_accounting: One terminal trace outcome per scanned source row in this precedence: invalid; known_or_new_game_overlap; source_role_board_overlap; repeated_accepted_puzzle_identity fatal; no_legal_matched_pair_after_all_filters; accepted. Also retain aggregate candidate move/pair filtering counts and exact source locations. Do not double-count a row into the terminal rejection sum.
intake_algorithm.row_validation: PuzzleId must be a nonempty ASCII alphanumeric string. Parse GameId exactly as above; parse source FEN as a valid orthodox python-chess Board. Reject malformed fields with a source-order trace. Split Moves at most once and parse ONLY its first token as a legal non-null setup move. Never inspect a later source answer token, rating, theme, opening or popularity.
intake_algorithm.setup: Keep source_before_fen; push exactly the first setup move; require a valid, nonterminal setup-after board with legal moves. This setup-after board is the pre-move model input. Check game and both source role keys against known history and already accepted new roles.
intake_algorithm.shortfall: A source cap shortfall, oracle mismatch, identity conflict, binding drift or output collision seals a failed intake with zero model calls. Do not resume, overwrite, silently drop, or select a replacement after outcomes.

known_history_exclusions.canonical_board_key: Exactly ' '.join(chess.Board(fen).fen().split()[:4]) using pinned python-chess 1.10.0, orthodox valid boards and default legal-en-passant normalization. Omit half/fullmove clocks for duplicate detection; retain the original complete canonical FEN for prompts.
known_history_exclusions.canonical_game_id: Full-match ([A-Za-z0-9]{8})(?:/(?:white|black))?(?:#[0-9]+)?; retain the case-sensitive first capture and original native GameId. Reject missing/malformed values; do not infer unknown game identities.
known_history_exclusions.constructed: Immutable constructed preboard and supplied c3h3 fact successor, plus every legal first move and both classifiers' legal raw/masked top5 successors from the completed sealed run 24401. Seven distinct legal moves produce six additional board keys; no invented game ID. Original game/history/mainline remain unknown; constructed clocks 0/1 are computational. No active raw, fact-label or model-quality score file was read for this amendment.
known_history_exclusions.earlier_fact_panel: All 16 earlier fact games, both source roles and their supplied-move successors.
known_history_exclusions.inventory_gate: At root's eventual intake GO, confirm that no additional spent cohort/game/board has appeared after this proposal. If current illustration execution or another experiment creates newly spent states not covered here, freeze a hash-bound registry amendment before selection; never read an active score file or silently expand after model outputs.
known_history_exclusions.legacy: 24 historical seed games including already-spent retained replay boards; all registered v1/v2/v3/v4 splits and both source-before/setup-after roles reconstructed from the retained 4 MiB prefix. The 24-item legacy broker-derived manifest adds no new game/board beyond this union, but remains hash-bound and checked.
known_history_exclusions.limits: Known board exclusions do not authenticate unknown video game identities, exclude their unknown full histories, or establish independence from upstream model pretraining.
known_history_exclusions.primary: All 8192 train, 128 development, 256 held-out primary positions: all 8576 games, source-before/setup-after keys, and the rule-constructible successor of every supplied fact move. No model-quality file or label is needed to reconstruct these roles.
known_history_exclusions.reconstruct_not_count_only: Before selection, rehash every bound input; reconstruct the existing registry and all added known roles; require exact sorted-game and sorted-board equality with the bound workspace registry, not merely matching counts.
known_history_exclusions.rollout: All 64 retained PGNs, their initial state and every legal mainline state:4784 known plies. These are designed software stress games, not real-game identity evidence.
known_history_exclusions.video: All three immutable illustrative preboards, known opening-history states and three displayed-move successors. These old evaluator observations serve only to exclude spent board keys and never enter candidate selection or any model prompt.
